source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 试探再紧，暗雷欲动
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC25 after EP02 SC24 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the tightening scrutiny into the next near-breakpoint: Keshadu's testing pressure sharpens further, Shisilang's pride keeps the scene unstable, Tuobaye is still trapped without understanding his own survival path, and the white-clothed woman's restraint feels one step away from turning into action.
title: 试探再紧，暗雷欲动

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC24 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC24 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing. SH03 required storyboard regeneration before pass.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 科沙度更近一步试探，十四郎继续羞怒逼压，白衣女子的暗线几乎将明。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 接下来这条线会继续收紧。科沙度的怀疑会更接近摊牌，十四郎也不会甘心退场，拓拔野仍被两面夹压而不知真正底牌所在。白衣女子的克制会越来越像暴风雨前最后的平静，为后续真正爆开的节点继续蓄力。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 下一段需要把试探和压迫继续转成更直接的临界点，让隐藏援手几乎无法再完全藏住。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant, restrained, and dangerous; no overt spell spectacle.
Keshadu stays cold, analytical, and increasingly near the truth.
Shisilang remains unstable from wounded pride, not calm or reset.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.

generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Keep the beat readable: sharper testing, wounded pride, trapped uncertainty, and near-exposed restraint should appear as separate visual steps.
